# Jamil Isaac Ramirez Muñoz

**B.Sc. in Mechanical Fluids Engineering**

Hydrology • Hydraulics • Water Resources

I am a Peruvian researcher working in hydrology, hydraulics and environmental data science, with a focus on hydrological modelling, precipitation extremes, uncertainty and reproducible research.

## Research portfolio · November 2026

**14 active articles · 4 published · 9 in review · 1 submitted**

The portfolio covers hydrological prediction, extreme rainfall, satellite and gridded precipitation, hydroclimatic variability, uncertainty and regionalization. The count excludes one previously rejected manuscript (A-015), which remains in the private editorial history.

[Explore published articles](publications.qmd) · [Research radar and editorial status](research-radar.qmd)

## Recent highlights

- Four peer-reviewed articles published in 2026 in *Ingeniería del Agua*, *Tecnología y ciencias del agua*, *RBRH* and *South Sustainability*.
- Research under editorial evaluation at *Hydrological Sciences Journal*, *Hydrological Processes*, *Water Resources Management*, *International Journal of Climatology*, *Theoretical and Applied Climatology*, *Water Science*, *RBRH* and other journals.
- Open hydrometeorological station-selection tools and reproducible research workflows available through GitHub and Zenodo.

## Research and tools

My current work examines rainfall–runoff modelling, observational record limitations, high-flow evaluation, hydroclimatic transferability and uncertainty. I also develop open tools for hydrometeorological data screening and watershed analysis.
